info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Offer Management API
info.description: The Customer Offer Management API allows businesses to update existing customer offers, facilitating personalized engagement and enhancing customer satisfaction. This API enables seamless modifications to offers based on evolving customer needs and preferences. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and customer relationship managers seeking to improve their outreach efforts. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can ensure that their offers remain relevant and compelling.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific customer offer identified by its unique ID (CUST-100045). Utilize this operation to modify various attributes of the offer as needed.

requestBody.description: Updates the customer offer details for the specified customer identifier. Please provide the necessary fields to modify the offer attributes as per business requirements.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the customer offer was updated.
